evidence.supports: Official minutes: text of Application #26-25 (12-month moratorium proposal), discussion, and the 5-1 vote to schedule (not adopt) a public hearing for September 24, 2026.
evidence.quote: The proposed timeframe for the Moratorium is twelve (12) months. ... A motion was made by Andrew Holt, seconded by Vincenzo Marfella, to accept and schedule Application #26-25 for a Public Hearing at a Special Meeting on September 24, 2026. Chair Kelly, Vincenzo Marfella, Andrew Holt, Nick Demetriades, Richard Nordmann approved; Michael Cannata opposed. The motion passed, 5 to 1.

evidence.supports: Secondary (AI-generated) meeting summary; checked and found to overstate the outcome (describes the item as 'approved'/'passed' when the official minutes show only a hearing was scheduled). Retained as evidence of the discrepancy, not as a source for the moratorium's status.
evidence.quote: The Cromwell Planning and Zoning Commission approved a text amendment to establish a moratorium on data centers, passing it with a 4-1 vote after debate that included opposition from Commissioner Mike Canada.

decisions.notes: Verified against the official filed minutes: the Aug. 18, 2026 vote (5-1) only scheduled a public hearing for Sept. 24, 2026; it did not adopt the moratorium. The researcher correctly caught and documented that a secondary aggregator (mytownview.com) mischaracterized this as 'approved'/'passed' with an incorrect 4-1 vote count -- the official minutes (5-1) are authoritative. 'pending' is correct.

evidence.supports: Primary source: full text of Resolution TC31-65 adopting the two-year moratorium on new data centers, listed for public hearing and action at the Sept. 9, 2026 Town Council meeting.
evidence.quote: RESOLUTION TC31-65: BE IT RESOLVED AND ORDAINED That the Trumbull Municipal Code be and the same is hereby amended by inclusion of the following: The Town hereby adopts a two-year moratorium on the establishment and development of any new data centers within the Town of Trumbull. (Public Hearing Town Council September 9, 2026)

evidence.supports: Confirms the unanimous voice vote, effective-immediately term, scope (new data centers only, not the 80 Merritt Blvd. modernization), and detailed public hearing testimony.
evidence.quote: TRUMBULL – The Trumbull Town Council took a tepid step Wednesday toward regulating data centers in town by approving a two-year moratorium effective immediately of building such facilities... the resolution approved unanimously by the council by voice vote only places a moratorium on all new data centers built. The resolution does not pertain to the work being done at the Trumbull Corporate Park on Merritt Boulevard.

evidence.supports: Independently confirms the Sept. 9, 2026 adoption date, the moratorium's scope exclusion for the existing 80 Merritt Blvd. facility, and resident reaction including a possible referendum petition drive.
evidence.quote: A decades-old data center in Trumbull could become one of the first AI data centers in Connecticut, despite the town passing a new 2-year moratorium on Wednesday. ... Trumbull's moratorium only applies to the 'establishment and development' of new data centers, not the proposed upgrades to the town's current facility...

decisions.notes: Verified against the primary resolution text (TC31-65) and two independent news accounts: unanimous Sept. 9, 2026 adoption, 2-year term, correctly scoped to exclude the existing 80 Merritt Blvd. facility's modernization. No duplicate.
